title: Getting Started with MongoDB and Spring AI
body: MongoDB is a document database that supports vector search. Spring AI provides a high-level API for integrating with LLMs and vector stores. In this tutorial, you will learn how to build a RAG application using these technologies. First, you need a MongoDB Atlas cluster. Then, configure your Spring Boot application with the necessary dependencies. Finally, use the ChatClient to query your data.

title: Advanced RAG Patterns
body: To improve RAG accuracy, consider using techniques like hybrid search, re-ranking, and sophisticated document chunking. Hybrid search combines keyword search with vector search. Re-ranking ensures the most relevant documents are at the top of the context window. Document chunking should consider semantic boundaries rather than just character limits.

title: What is RAG?
body: RAG stands for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. It is an AI framework that improves the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) responses by grounding the model on external sources of knowledge to supplement the LLM's internal representation of information. Instead of relying purely on what it was trained on, a RAG system first retrieves relevant documents from a vector database and then gives those documents to the LLM to read before generating an answer.
